title: Where the sun sets into the sea: sea sunsets and sunrises at the beaches of Britain and Ireland
excerpt: I traced the Sun's path from 1,717 beaches in Britain and Ireland, day by day: 47% see the Sun set into open sea on some day of the year, only 52 every day, and islands like Arran and Lundy take a bite out of the year.
seo_description: Which beaches in Britain and Ireland see the sun set into the sea, or rise out of it, and on which days? 1,717 beaches, day by day.
header_alt: Title card on parchment reading 'Where the sun sets into the sea' in black and red lettering beside a drawing of an orange sun on a blue sea horizon, with the share of beaches that see a sea sunset and a sea sunrise.
